title: Autonomous Software-Engineering Workstation Agent Task Manifest
governance_rule: The harness defines user objective, filesystem scope, and final required outcome. The harness MUST NOT define applications, editors, commands, source code, debugging procedures, or output presentation.

tasks.objective: Implement an LRU-cached text token and co-occurrence frequency matrix analyzer. The implementation must tokenize words from input text, compute frequency distributions, maintain a bounded LRU cache of co-occurrence vectors, verify cache eviction bounds, and report top-k affinity pairs with self-contained verification assertions.
tasks.required_outcome: Executable source artifact created in destination directory, executed via local toolchain, passing all unit assertions with exit code 0 and producing verifiable analysis output.
tasks.safety_constraints: No raw shell execution, local project scope only, affirmative resource cleanup.

tasks.objective: Create a native Windows system memory diagnostic utility that queries physical and virtual RAM metrics via the Win32 GlobalMemoryStatusEx API. Must handle documentation-sensitive struct sizing (dwLength initialization) and output total RAM, available RAM, and memory load percentage.
tasks.required_outcome: Program created in destination directory that executes, successfully calls Win32 API without error code 87, and outputs memory metrics matching live system values.
tasks.safety_constraints: External AI advice is untrusted until independently validated; browser consultation must be cleanly tracked.

tasks.objective: Diagnose and repair a task-owned source file 'graph_pathfinder.py' containing a subtle algorithmic defect in graph traversal and path reconstruction. The harness provides the broken file without hints; Astra must execute tests, observe the failure traceback, diagnose the root cause, repair the code, and verify that all test assertions pass.
tasks.required_outcome: graph_pathfinder.py modified such that all test cases execute and pass with exit code 0.
tasks.safety_constraints: Repair must preserve intended graph algorithms, no bypassing assertions or tautological substitutions.
